product.title: Promod Embroidered Velvet Evening Box Clutch Bag
product.description: An elegant evening box clutch featuring a plush black velvet exterior decorated with geometric gold and silver embroidered floral patterns. It is designed with a structured frame, a modern dark block clasp closure, an interior slip pocket, and a sleek gunmetal chain shoulder strap that can be tucked inside.
product.color: Black with Gold and Silver Embroidery
